result.plan:
## Picked Sheriff

**OCFL (Orange County / Orlando)** — the only one of the six probed sheriffs that exposes STREET + APTNUM + CITY + STATE + ZIPCODE in its detail JSON, which is the load-bearing requirement for joining a booking to a `Parcel` row. No captcha, no Cloudflare challenge, vanilla Chrome UA works (no Playwright runtime needed), a static daily PDF gives a finite ~150-250 bookings/day enumeration surface, SSN is server-suppressed and juveniles excluded (Ch.119 compliance free), and the probe script already produced three artifact JSON files. JSO/MDCR/PBSO/BSO/HCSO all fail the address requirement, the captcha-budget requirement, or both.

## v0 Schema Delta

Two **additive** models in the `flipops` namespace. Property model untouched.

**`BondDistressRecord`** (additive) — raw OCFL booking ingest, one row per booking event.
Critical fields: `id`, `sourceCounty` ("12095"), `sourceKey` (FK to ScrapeRegistry: `ocfl-sheriff-bookings`), `bookingNumber` (unique with sourceCounty+sourceKey), `inmateFirstName`, `inmateLastName`, `inmateDOB`, `bookingDate`, `releaseDate?`, `chargeSummary` (Json), `bondAmount?`, `bookingAddressRaw`, `bookingAddressNormalized`, `normalizedFullName`, `mugshotBase64` (NOT persisted — column omitted in v0), `capturedAt`, `raw` (Json).
Indexes: `(normalizedFullName)`, `(bookingAddressNormalized)`, `(bookingDate)`, `(sourceCounty, bookingNumber, sourceKey)` unique.

**`BondDistressReview`** (additive) — review lifecycle, one row per record.
Critical fields: `id`, `bondDistressRecordId` (FK unique), `reviewerUserId` (FK User), `status` (`pending|approved|rejected|deferred`), `matchedCountyFips?`, `matchedApn?`, `matchConfidence?` (Float), `matchMethod?` (`manual|exact-address|exact-name`), `reviewerNotes?`, `reviewedAt?`, `promotedPropertyId?` (FK Property).
Indexes: `(status, reviewerUserId)`, `(promotedPropertyId)`.

**Schema sync:** `npx prisma db push` only. **Never `prisma migrate dev`** (CLAUDE.md: drift will wipe data). Run against Railway PG with `synchronous_commit=OFF` semantics already in place.

## v0 API Surface

All routes admin-gated (Clerk role check); none extend `/api/properties` UNION.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/admin/bond-distress/ingest` | Scraper/manual entrypoint — accepts `{ sourceKey, records[] }`, upserts BondDistressRecord. Token-gated via `ADMIN_INGEST_TOKEN`. |
| GET | `/api/admin/bond-distress/queue?status=pending&cursor=&limit=` | Returns pending records with top-3 candidate Parcel matches computed server-side. |
| POST | `/api/admin/bond-distress/[id]/approve` | Body `{ countyFips, apn, matchConfidence, matchMethod, notes? }`. Creates BondDistressReview, calls internal promote-to-Property mirroring `/api/properties/promote`, stamps `dataSource='bond-distress-manual'`, applies `+15` flat score boost. |
| POST | `/api/admin/bond-distress/[id]/reject` | Body `{ reason }`. Status='rejected', no Property created, audit row retained. |

## v0 UI Surface

**Create:**
- `app/app/admin/bond-distress/page.tsx` — review queue (left panel = pending list, right panel = single record with candidate Parcel cards + Approve/Reject/Defer).
- `lib/bond-distress/match-candidates.ts` — shared candidate-computation helper.
- `lib/bond-distress/normalize.ts` — name/address normalizers.

**Modify:**
- `app/components/lead-filter-bar.tsx` — add "Bond Distress" filter chip (filters Property rows where `dataSource='bond-distress-manual'`).
- `app/components/lead-list-panel.tsx` — add slate "Jail" badge variant rendered when `dataSource='bond-distress-manual'`.
- `app/components/lead-detail-sheet.tsx` — add small "Bond Distress" section showing `bookingDate`, `bondAmount`, `chargeSummary` from the linked BondDistressRecord. **Neutral copy only** — no "arrest/jail/bond" language on the public investor surface beyond the chip label; investigation 1 flagged this as a privacy risk.

**Manual-review operator flow:** Operator opens `/app/admin/bond-distress`. Left panel shows the pending queue sorted by `bookingDate DESC` with name, charge headline, bond amount, county. Click a row → right panel loads the record's full detail (charges, booking address, DOB) plus three candidate Parcel cards each showing owner name, situs address, distance-to-booking-address, and a computed confidence (0-1) with the heuristic shown ("exact address" / "last name + first initial" / "county only"). Operator clicks the correct Parcel → `Approve` POST → record disappears from queue and a new Property row appears in `/app/leads` within seconds (revalidate on success). If none of the three are right, operator picks "Manual search" (free-form APN entry) or "Reject" with a reason. One record per click; no bulk-approve in v0.

## v0 Ingest

- **MANUAL TRIGGER ONLY.** No cron, no BullMQ worker registration. The scraper is invoked via `npx tsx scripts/ingest-ocfl-bookings.ts` or by hitting `/api/admin/bond-distress/ingest` with the token.
- Scraper location: **`lib/scrapers/vendors/ocfl-sheriff.ts`** — fetches the daily PDF index, enumerates booking IDs, hits the JSON detail+charges endpoints, normalizes, POSTs batch to `/api/admin/bond-distress/ingest`. Reuses `lib/scrapers/base/http-client.ts politeFetch` with `useProxy: true` (Bright Data US residential).
- **Yellow-zone hardening per FL-COVERAGE-PLAN §5.1:**
  1. Tag every `RawSnapshot` row with `legalRisk='yellow'` so the one-SQL purge works.
  2. Per-source kill-switch env `OCFL_BOOKINGS_ENABLED=true` checked at scraper entry; flipping false hard-stops next invocation.
  3. Polite cadence: one PDF + ~250 detail calls spread over 30+ min, jittered, US-egress proxy, vanilla Chrome UA.
  4. Mugshot base64 **discarded at parse time**, never written to `BondDistressRecord` or `RawSnapshot`.
  5. ScrapeRegistry row seeded with `legalRisk='yellow'`, `requiresOutsideCounselSignoff=true` flag tracked in metadata.
  6. No persistence of juveniles (server-side excluded anyway) or sealed/expunged records.

## v0 Identity Matching

**Human-decide, no auto-link.** At queue-fetch time, server runs a SQL query for each pending BondDistressRecord and returns top-3 candidate Parcels scored:
- exact `bookingAddressNormalized == Parcel.situsAddressNormalized` → 0.6
- exact `inmateLastName + firstInitial` match in `Parcel.ownerName` → 0.3
- `sourceCounty == Parcel.countyFips` → 0.1

Operator sees all three, ranked by score, and clicks the right one — **the server never auto-commits a match regardless of confidence**. No Levenshtein, no Soundex, no DOB join (Parcel has no DOB). If zero candidates score >0 (orphan), the record still appears in the queue with a "No candidates" state and a manual-APN-entry input. `matchMethod` is logged on every approval for later precision/recall measurement.

## v0 Scoring

**Bond-distress does NOT feed `calculateDistressScoreFromProperty`.** Approved Property rows receive a flat `+15` boost applied at promote-time only, inside the approve route, via a small `applyBondDistressBoost(score)` helper. `scoreBreakdown.signals.bondDistress=true` is stamped so v1 can re-score from data once we have close-rate evidence. Rationale: the scorer is materialized into `TaxDelinquencySummary.score` and `Property.score`; adding a new signal to the deterministic SQL aggregate forces a full re-score of the freshness layer — out of scope. Also, the weight is a guess until backtested.

## Explicit Exclusions

1. **No virtual rows** in `/api/properties` — bond-distress never appears in the public leads UNION before manual approval.
2. **No cron / no BullMQ registration** — ingest is manual-trigger only in v0.
3. **No bulk approve** — one record per click; no "approve all above 0.8" button.
4. **No fuzzy/Levenshtein/Soundex/DOB matching** — exact normalized name+address only; operator judgment fills the gap.
5. **No mugshot persistence** — base64 discarded at parse time, never stored.
6. **No additional sheriffs** — JSO, PBSO, HCSO, BSO, MDCR all deferred to v1+. OCFL only.
7. **No auto skip-trace on approve** — operator still clicks Skip Trace manually like any other lead.
8. **No Property schema changes** — no `bondDistressAmount`/`bondDistressDate` columns; data lives in BondDistressRecord with FK from Property.metadata.
9. **No bond-distress-specific notification** — approved Property surfaces through the normal lead-list flow.
